# bb clone

Clone a repository to the local filesystem

```text
bb clone <repository> [directory] [-- <gitflags>...] [flags]
```

`--https`
:   Use HTTPS only and skip the SSH clone attempt

`--no-upstream`
:   Do not add an upstream remote when cloning a fork

`--ssh`
:   Use SSH only and disable HTTPS fallback

`-u, --upstream-remote-name string`
:   Upstream remote name when cloning a fork (default "upstream")

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Shows that it would clone into a new directory, without doing it; nothing is checked first (predicted)
